async function craftOneMoreIronShovel(bot) {
    // The function attempts to create one more iron shovel if the current count is less than the target. It first checks if enough sticks are available, crafting planks from logs if necessary to make sticks. If an iron ingot is missing, it checks for raw iron and coal to smelt the necessary ingot using a nearby furnace. Finally, it crafts the iron shovel if all required materials are present.
}
